name: PC Engine SuperGrafx
description: NEC's 1989 upgraded PC Engine with a second video processor, four times the work RAM and double the VRAM. It ran every standard HuCard but received only a handful of its own games, making it one of the rarest Japanese consoles.

specs.graphics: 2× HuC6270 VDC + HuC6202 priority controller + HuC6260 VCE

curiosities: Only five games were released that required the SuperGrafx, including a celebrated port of Capcom's Daimakaimura (Ghouls 'n Ghosts).
It was sold only in Japan.
Its second video processor lets it draw two independent background layers and twice as many sprites as a standard PC Engine.
It also plays every standard PC Engine HuCard.
bestsellers: Aldynes: The Misson Code for Rage Crisis
story: NEC released the SuperGrafx in Japan in 1989 as an upgraded PC Engine.
It had a second graphics chip but only a handful of games used it, such as Ghouls 'n Ghosts.
It was a commercial failure, but is popular with collectors.
